user.title: Activity Levels
user.description: Create the Activity Levels integration. Groups, envelopes and stimuli are configured afterwards in the Activity Levels sidebar panel.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Fire a synthetic impulse on a group, as if a stimulus had activated.

set_level.name: Set level
set_level.description: Override a group's level: its built-in trigger is sized so the group reads this value, and cools down from there.

value.name: Value
value.description: The level the group should read, clamped to its maximum.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Return every trigger in a group (or all groups) to idle.

group_id.name: Group
group_id.description: Group id; omit to reset every group.

rebuild_profile.name: Rebuild profile
rebuild_profile.description: Retrain the built-in activity profile from long-term statistics now.

force.name: Force
force.description: Overwrite a profile written by an external producer.

simulate_now.name: Simulate now
simulate_now.description: Sample a presence-simulation plan for a group and start it immediately, ignoring the presence simulation switches.

bermuda_missing.title: Bermuda is not installed
bermuda_missing.description: Activity Levels has presence tracking switched on, but the Bermuda BLE Trilateration integration is not installed, so there is nothing to estimate rooms from. Install Bermuda, or turn presence off in the Presence tab of the Activity Levels panel, then reload Activity Levels.

not_a_bermuda_device.title: Tracked device is not a Bermuda device_tracker
not_a_bermuda_device.description: These tracked devices could not be resolved to a Bermuda device_tracker and are being ignored, each with the reason: {entities}. Pick a device_tracker that Bermuda created, in the Presence tab of the Activity Levels panel.

disabled_distance_sensors.title: Bermuda distance sensors are disabled
disabled_distance_sensors.description: Bermuda ships its per-scanner distance sensors disabled, and these are still off: {entities}. Enable them under Settings > Devices & services > Bermuda > the tracked device, then reload Activity Levels.

unmapped_scanners.title: Some Bermuda scanners are in no room
unmapped_scanners.description: These scanners are not in an area that any room group claims, so their readings are ignored: {scanners}. Give the scanner device an area that matches a room's area, or map it directly with presence.scanner_areas, then reload Activity Levels.

transition_infeasible.title: Presence settings cannot make a transition matrix
transition_infeasible.description: {detail} Presence stays off until this is fixed in the Presence tab of the Activity Levels panel.
